blockingPrinciple: A calculator is disabled where the controlling geometry or installation rule cannot be established from the supplied documents.

items.issue: The slab drawing combines an overall +10 to +30 mm opening with 5 to 20 mm edge clearances.
items.decision: Store overall oversize and per-edge constraints separately; do not assume central positioning.

items.issue: Ordinary masonry pages do not publish a complete numerical opening rule.
items.decision: Keep those methods guidance-only unless the official drawing or hole-sizing logic is available.

items.issue: Type A light-wall opening is +75 in the installation booklet and +70 in the short datasheet.
items.decision: Use +75 provisionally and show an audit warning.

items.issue: Published tables are based on centralised installation but the detailed AFS constraints permit non-central positioning.
items.decision: Store table result and edge-limit logic separately; maximum case-to-edge clearance 130 mm, recommended batt space 25 mm.

items.issue: Nominal duct and casing/frame dimensions are not interchangeable.
items.decision: Every setting-out calculation must identify its geometry reference explicitly.

items.issue: FSD-TD-C uses circular spigots on a rectangular multiblade casing, while FSD-TD-O lacks an explicit orderable flat-oval size/configuration table in the supplied series document.
items.decision: Enable FSD-TD-C only for the listed circular diameter table and calculate through the rectangular casing/method chain. Keep FSD-TD-O verification-required and do not extrapolate flat-oval configurations.

items.family: FD Series Type C with Angle Frame
items.issue: The product code FD-C-AF can be confused with the separate FD-C Series circular single-blade damper. A site label confirms an FD-C-AF at Ø355.
items.decision: Create a distinct FD-C-AF product path. Apply the FD Series Type C circular-spigot and rectangular-casing geometry before the selected FD-AF method's 10 ±5 mm casing gap. Do not add Ø355 or Ø560 to FSD-TD-C.

entries.summary: Improved the mobile offset-calculator controls and site wording without changing the calculation engine.
controls: Straight-cut result is labelled as the cut straight between bends
Standard circular duct sizes use a quick selector with a custom-size fallback
Existing bend take-off tables, offset formulae and 120 mm editable swedge-limit warning are unchanged
The fit warning is displayed immediately below the primary result

entries.summary: Added the BSB FD Series FD-C-AF curtain-blade circular-spigot product as a separate calculator family, including verified Ø355 and Ø560 geometry.
controls: FD-C-AF is not conflated with FD-C Series or FSD-TD-C
Nominal diameter, D-3 spigot, rectangular casing, Angle Frame and aperture remain separate
FD M9/M10/M11 retain the published 10 ±5 mm casing-gap tolerance

entries.summary: Added listed-diameter FSD-TD-C calculations, explicitly structured FSD-TD-S/C/O variants, and preserved nominal spigot to rectangular casing to clearance to structural opening geometry.
controls: No opening calculated from circular spigot diameter alone
No diameter extrapolation outside the FSD-TD-C table
FSD-TD-O remains disabled pending an explicit size/configuration table

entries.summary: Added method-specific builder setting-out mapping and Lindab engineering database for FNC1, WH25, WH45, WK25, WK45 and WKS25. FNC1U remains locked pending installation manual.
controls: Centred opening used only where shown/defined by tested opening detail
